# Character Class Template

## Character Class Creation Guide

Use this template when designing new character classes. Each class should have a unique identity, mechanical specialization, and thematic coherence within the chosen setting.

## Basic Class Information

### Required Fields
- **Class Name**: [Thematic role name]
- **Mechanical Specialization**: [Attack/Skill/Power/Fortune]  
- **Playstyle Description**: [High-level gameplay approach]
- **Thematic Role**: [Historical/setting context]

### Starting Statistics
```
Health: [XX/XX]        # Total health pool
Sanity: [XX/XX]        # Mental health/corruption resistance  
Energy: [X/X]          # Cards playable per turn
Gold: [XX]             # Starting currency
```

## Class Design Framework

### 1. Mechanical Identity

#### Primary Specialization (70% of cards)
- **Category**: [Attack/Skill/Power/Fortune]
- **Unique Mechanics**: [Special rules or interactions]
- **Resource Management**: [How they use energy/sanity/gold]

#### Secondary Categories (30% of cards)  
- **Support Categories**: [Which other categories they use]
- **Cross-Synergies**: [How other categories support their main strategy]

### 2. Thematic Identity

#### Historical Context
- **Time Period**: [When they operated]
- **Social Status**: [Place in society] 
- **Economic Role**: [How they made living]
- **Survival Strategy**: [Approach to goldfield dangers]

#### Character Motivation
- **Why They're Here**: [What brought them to the goldfields]
- **What They Want**: [Primary goal/motivation]
- **What They Fear**: [Greatest threat or weakness]

### 3. Starting Deck Composition

#### Basic Cards (10 cards)
Essential cards that define the class's fundamental capabilities:

```
[Card Name] x[Count] ([Energy] energy [category])
- Effect: [Brief description]
- Purpose: [Role in deck/strategy]

Example:
Pickaxe Strike x3 (1 energy Attack)
- Effect: Deal 6 damage  
- Purpose: Basic damage dealing
```

#### Signature Cards (5 cards)
Unique cards that showcase the class specialization:

```
[Signature Card Name] x[Count] ([Energy] energy [category])
- Effect: [Unique effect description]
- Specialization: [How it showcases class identity]
```

### 4. Class Mechanics

#### Core Passive Ability
```
[Ability Name]: [Description of persistent class advantage]

Example:
Gold Rush: Each Fortune card played increases next Fortune card's effectiveness by 1
```

#### Resource Synergies
- **Primary Resource**: [Which resource they care about most]
- **Resource Generation**: [How they generate resources]
- **Resource Spending**: [Unique ways they spend resources]

#### Unique Interactions
- **With Cards**: [Special interactions with certain card types]
- **With Systems**: [Special interactions with game mechanics]
- **With Enemies**: [Advantages/disadvantages vs certain enemies]

This template ensures character classes are well-designed, balanced, and integrate properly with the theme-agnostic core system while providing unique and engaging gameplay experiences.
